entries.proposition: ALLELE 1 of the WWOX patient: a nonsense variant (PVS1-based Pathogenic call), heterozygous, inherited from one parent; transcript NM_016373.2. The codon lies in the last coding exon (exon 9 starts at c.1057 by LEGEND's boundary map), a point the paper does not make.
entries.snippet: AR NM_016373.2 c.1060C > T p.Gln354Ter Heterozygosity Pathogenic PVS1, PM2, PM3, PP4

entries.proposition: ALLELE 2 of the WWOX patient: an intragenic duplication of exons 6-8, Likely pathogenic without PVS1, inherited from the other parent. Phase is established by parental testing; whether the duplication is tandem and in frame is not reported.
entries.snippet: AR NM_016373.2 exon 6–8 duplication _ Heterozygosity Likely pathogenic PM2, PM3, PP4, PP5

entries.proposition: HOW THE DUPLICATION WAS CALLED: relative read depth on the panel, confirmation of exon-level CNVs by MLPA.
entries.snippet: Large exonic deletions and duplications were confirmed using the MLPA kit (MRC Holland).

entries.proposition: Figure 2 a-2 inspected: normalized depth for the WWOX patient is raised across WWOX exons 6, 7 and 8 of NM_016373 and returns to baseline at exon 9, with the ExomeDepth call bar spanning those exons.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2 panel a-2 (WWOX): nine exon boxes on NM_016373; the purple normalized-depth trace sits about +0.3 to +0.5 over boxes 6-8 and near 0 elsewhere; red bar labelled 'Heterozygous duplication of exon 6-8'.

entries.proposition: HETEROZYGOUS CARRIERS, class level: both parents of every proband were asymptomatic by an inclusion criterion; the WWOX patient's two parents each carry one of the two alleles. 'Asymptomatic' is an enrolment condition, not a reported examination.

entries.proposition: PHENOTYPE BAND OF THE WWOX PATIENT: the supplement places the one WWOX patient in the infantile-spasm group; no other per-patient phenotype is published.
